frame.origin_is: plan (0,0) = axis a x axis 1 (west gable, back line of the tower)
frame.bearing_note: plan +x (a->J) points SSE along Pavle Todria St; plan +y (street side) points bearing 244.63 (WSW). UTM grid bearing; grid convergence -0.009 deg (negligible)
frame.mirror_note: plan y is 90 deg CLOCKWISE from x (drawn y-down). E = E0 + x*sin(b) + y*sin(b+90); N = N0 + x*cos(b) + y*cos(b+90), b=bearing_deg
frame.scale_note: plan metres = ground metres; free fit gave 0.974 (roof corner picking error); UTM point scale here 0.99960

far_context.river_terrace_scarp: river terrace edge ~8-10 m drop: ~650-750 m due E (bearing 90) and ~500-550 m ESE (bearing 120) of the site; absent at bearing 60. Floodplain below at ~327-332 m
far_context.river: Mtkvari (Kura) nearest centreline ~1.42 km E (OSM way 944567355, bearing 89); 1.68 km ENE; 2.17 km SSE. Not in the 1 km grid
far_context.hills: Yaghluja ridge rises SW from ~1.5 km (to 400 m at 2.5 km W, 600 m+ further SW): visible backdrop, not local relief

sources.imagery: Esri World Imagery, Vantor Vivid 2025-11-06, 0.34-0.45 m
sources.heights: shadow lengths on the imagery, calibrated on 29 OSM-tagged blocks (1.75 m shadow / m height); see height_source per building
